A must whose value is read from another listing is ONE must holding the whole description of that listing ("rim colour: unlike the rim colour of the kettle Ovarno sells with a glass lid"): words that describe that other listing (its shop, its kind, "with <property> <value> and <property> <value>" after it) stay inside that one must and are never musts of this product}. "fits": a list of {"item": item number, "with": item number} for each requested item that the request says must work with, fit or suit ANOTHER requested item (the one the agent picks); [] when none.
